Storage Best Practices

Client meetings: Always export to OneDrive before 90-day purge. Insurance: 18-month reference window. Real Estate: 4-year retention.

Internal standups: No need to keep. Delete after review to save storage quota.

Use Outlook email: For long-term sharing, send video links via Outlook. Storage is unlimited on email vs CRM quota.

OneDrive limit: Be mindful of OneDrive storage plan when bulk-exporting large meeting recordings.
